name: Restorer
summary: Restorers carefully tend to the health of both the environment and creatures in it.
replacesText: Nature Sense; Spontanteous Casting; Resist Nature's Lore; A Thousand Faces

features.name: Healing Touch (Ex)
features.summary: A restorer gains a +2 bonus on Heal checks. When a restorer uses Heal to provide first aid, the bonus increases to +3. This ability replaces nature sense.

features.name: Natural Medic
features.summary: A restorer can channel stored spell energy into healing spells that she did not prepare ahead of time. The restorer can “lose” any prepared spell in order to cast any cure spell she can cast of the same spell level or lower (a cure spell is any spell with “cure” in its name). This ability replaces spontaneous casting.

features.name: Enemy of Blight (Ex)
features.summary: At 4th level, a restorer can ignore the effects of an overgrown area that has been magically manipulated to impede motion. She can ignore these effects for a number of rounds per day equal to double her Wisdom bonus. These rounds don’t have to be used consecutively. This ability replaces resist nature’s lure.

features.name: Guide across Lifetimes (Sp)
features.summary: At 13th level, once per day as a full-round action, a restorer can cast reincarnate without a material component. This ability replaces a thousand faces.

mechanicalNotes: Replacement progression is automated. Bespoke effects without a shared builder subsystem remain descriptive.
